events.title: Gallery Reading with The Parathist
events.description: A 90-minute evening of connection and mediumship with our own Nicole Smith-Merry, who shares intuitive impressions and messages for members of the audience in a group setting. The venue is next to the historic Orphanage, with parking across the street at the Gettysburg Tour Center. Not every attendee is guaranteed an individual message, and tickets are non-refundable.
events.location: 1866 Event Space, 777 Baltimore St., Suite 102, Gettysburg, PA
